rail.outlook: West Yorkshire Mass Transit is UK's largest unfunded transport scheme at £2.5bn. Supertram renewal in Sheffield. TransPennine Route Upgrade transforming Manchester-York-Leeds corridor. Doncaster emerging as national rail hub.

maritime.outlook: Humber ports driving offshore wind supply chain development. Able Marine Energy Park purpose-built for wind. ABP Humber investing across Hull, Immingham, and Grimsby. Green Port Hull established.

real-estate.outlook: Leeds South Bank is largest city centre regeneration outside London. Sheffield Heart of City II progressing. Bradford One City Park and city centre transformation. York Central development at former railway lands.

utilities.outlook: Yorkshire Water delivering £7.8bn AMP8 programme with major focus on storm overflows. Northern Powergrid grid reinforcement for industrial electrification. Drax BECCS project significant.

infrastructure.outlook: Significant flood defence investment in Humber estuary and Yorkshire rivers. NHS estate modernisation. School rebuilding programme active. Waste and circular economy investment.

opportunities.title: Dogger Bank Wind Farm — Onshore Connection Works
opportunities.description: Onshore connection and substation works for Dogger Bank A/B/C (3.6GW total). World's largest offshore wind farm. Onshore works at Creyke Beck (East Riding) and Lackenby substation (Teesside). Connected to grid 2024.

opportunities.title: H2H Saltend — Low-Carbon Hydrogen & CCS (600MW)

opportunities.title: Humber Hydrogen Hub — Pipeline, Storage & Distribution

opportunities.title: Thorpe Marsh Battery Energy Storage System (1.45GW)
opportunities.description: 1.45GW battery energy storage system at former Thorpe Marsh power station site, Doncaster. One of the largest BESS projects in the UK. Supports grid stability and renewable energy integration.

opportunities.title: Eggborough Battery Energy Storage System (500MW)
opportunities.description: 500MW BESS project at the former Eggborough power station site, Selby. SSE-led. Brownfield reuse of former coal power station for grid-scale battery storage.

opportunities.title: Third Energy — Ryedale Battery Energy Storage (100MW)
opportunities.description: 100MW battery energy storage facility in Ryedale, North Yorkshire. Third Energy project supporting grid flexibility and decarbonisation targets.

opportunities.title: LNER — Hull Paragon Interchange Enhancements
opportunities.fundingStatus: Secured — LNER / Hull City Council joint investment
opportunities.description: Regeneration and enhancement of Hull Paragon Interchange. Revitalising unused floor space, new heritage bar, bus-side enhancements, and public realm improvements. Award-winning project 2025.

opportunities.title: A66 Northern Trans-Pennine Dualling
opportunities.description: Dualling of the A66 between Penrith and Scotch Corner (~55 miles). Major National Highways RIS2 scheme. Reprieved after earlier pause. Procurement underway. Key freight and commuter route across Northern Pennines.

opportunities.title: A629 WYCA Halifax–Huddersfield Corridor
opportunities.description: A629 corridor improvements between Halifax and Huddersfield. West Yorkshire CA CRSTS-funded. Pre-construction development phase. Focuses on improved journey times, active travel integration, and congestion reduction.

opportunities.title: A1(M) Junction 42 Upgrade (Leeds West / South Milford)
opportunities.description: Upgrade of A1(M) Junction 42 to improve safety, reduce journey times, and increase reliability for freight and commuter traffic. Under National Highways development. Funding route to be confirmed.

opportunities.title: A64 York–Scarborough Dualling Upgrade

opportunities.title: Grimsby Port — Offshore Wind Operations Base (RWE)
opportunities.description: RWE offshore wind operations and maintenance hub at Grimsby. Hub opened 2025. Strategic location adjacent to major North Sea wind farms. Supports long-term O&M requirements for Humber offshore wind cluster.

opportunities.title: Goole Port — Inland Waterways Development (Humber Freeport)
opportunities.description: Inland waterways investment and expansion at Goole Port as part of Humber Freeport programme. Goole is a Humber Freeport tax site. Investment in port infrastructure to support renewable energy and clean growth logistics.

opportunities.title: Cadent Gas — Yorkshire Network Modernisation
opportunities.description: RIIO-GD2 regulated investment replacing old iron mains and preparing the Yorkshire gas distribution network for lower-carbon fuels. Ongoing mains replacement programme across the Yorkshire distribution zone.

opportunities.title: Leeds Flood Alleviation Scheme — Phase 2
opportunities.fundingStatus: Secured — Environment Agency / Leeds City Council / WYCA
opportunities.description: Phase 2 of the Leeds Flood Alleviation Scheme along the River Aire. Extends upstream of Phase 1. Protects homes, businesses, and enables city centre development. Arup-designed scheme with Environment Agency delivery.
